import sys
from collections import defaultdict

def dfs(u, parent, low, disc, ap, visited, graph):
    children = 0
    visited[u] = True
    disc[u] = low[u] = dfs.time
    dfs.time += 1
    for v in graph[u]:
        if not visited[v]:
            children += 1
            dfs(v, u, low, disc, ap, visited, graph)
            low[u] = min(low[u], low[v])
            if parent != -1 and low[v] >= disc[u]:
                ap[u] = True
        elif v != parent:
            low[u] = min(low[u], disc[v])
    if parent == -1 and children > 1:
        ap[u] = True

def doctorStrange(N, M, graph):
    visited = [False] * (N + 1)
    disc = [float('inf')] * (N + 1)
    low = [float('inf')] * (N + 1)
    ap = [False] * (N + 1)
    dfs.time = 0
    for i in range(1, N + 1):
        if not visited[i]:
            dfs(i, -1, low, disc, ap, visited, graph)
    return sum(ap)
